core_principles: Zone-Based Layout: Primary actions in the bottom 30% of the screen for one-handed use.
Cognitive Ease: Minimal text, large touch targets, soothing colors.
Safety First: Blue tones to reduce anxiety; avoid aggressive red for alerts unless critical.
Depth over Flatness: Use subtle colored shadows and blurs to create a soft, tactile feel.

usage_rules: Body text should have relaxed line-height for calmness.

primary.description: Deep Ocean Blue - Trust, Stability. Used for primary actions (Urge button).

secondary.description: Sage Leaf - Growth, Calm. Used for success states, secondary buttons.

accent.description: Warm Coral - Use sparingly for highlights or 'Stop' actions that shouldn't be aggressive red.

background.description: Ice Water - Very pale cool blue-grey for app background.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Mobile-first, single column. Use 'container' class with 'max-w-md' for mobile view simulation on desktop.
one_handed_mode: Place primary 'Urge' button fixed at the bottom (sticky) or in the bottom 20% of the viewport.
Navigation bar must be at the bottom.
Top 30% of screen reserved for viewing (Greeting, Status), not interacting.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-14 rounded-full text-lg shadow-lg shadow-primary/20 transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary/20 text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/30 text-teal-900 h-12 rounded-full

cards.default: bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/20 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] rounded-3xl p-6

inputs.default: h-12 bg-white/50 border-transparent focus:border-primary/20 focus:bg-white focus:ring-4 focus:ring-primary/5 rounded-xl transition-all

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise texture overlay (opacity 0.03) on the main background to reduce digital harshness.

motion.page_transition: initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }} exit={{ opacity: 0, y: -20 }} transition={{ duration: 0.4, ease: [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] }}
motion.micro_interactions: Active scale down (0.98) on buttons. Staggered entrance for list items.
motion.breathing_animation: animate-pulse-slow (4s cycle) for the calm timer.

assets.image_style: Calm, nature-inspired, desaturated or cool-toned. Avoid high-energy warm colors.
assets.icons: Lucide React (rounded variant). Stroke width 1.5px for lightness.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is #1B262C on light backgrounds. Sage green backgrounds must use dark text or very high contrast white.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use standard HTML <input> or <select>. Use Shadcn Input/Select components customized with the 'inputs.default' styles above.
Implement the 'Urge' button as a fixed or sticky element at the bottom of the Home screen.
Use 'Manrope' from Google Fonts. Import it in index.css.
For the 'Breathing' animation, create a custom keyframe in tailwind.config.js.
Ensure the layout is responsive but optimized for mobile (max-width containers centered on desktop).
universal_guidelines: Do NOT center align the app container. Keep text natural (left-aligned) for readability.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical. p-8 or p-10 is good.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients.
